journey.name: usdt send review and details
journey.description: Use an onboarded wallet with USDT, a fresh BTC/USD rate, an owned recipient and existing sent/received activity. Quotes require the service with MAX support. No payment is submitted.

actions.action: Open USDT Send and enter the owned recipient. On Amount, verify the BTC equivalent above the dollar amount, 32-point gap before Available balance, USDT badge, MAX and network pill. Enter a six-decimal amount and verify no precision is lost.

Open the network pill and select another EVM network. Verify the amount and valid recipient remain. Change to Solana with an EVM recipient and verify recipient entry is required. Enter an owned plain Solana address and verify the previous amount remains. Return to Arbitrum, enter the owned EVM address and verify the amount still remains.

From recipient entry with another network selected, paste an explicit Arbitrum USDT URI. Verify the selected network becomes Arbitrum and the link amount is retained. A plain 0x address preserves the selected network.
Tap MAX. Verify it fills a positive amount below the balance and remains on Amount. Continue and verify the payment plus maximum fee fits within the balance. Back out without swiping.

Enter a smaller amount and continue. Verify the collapsed review shows the amount, coin illustration, Show Details and teal Swipe To Pay. Show Details reveals Pay from, Network, Payment, Fee and Address, with the fee note above the swipe control. Displayed amounts round to cents; nonzero values below one cent show <0.01. Hide Details restores the illustration. Cancel without paying.

Prepare a cross-network payment and continue. Without scrolling, verify Maximum total debit (id "UsdtMaximumTotal") and its value are fully visible above Swipe To Pay. Show Details and verify the maximum remains visible. Cancel without paying.

Open an existing sent USDT activity. Verify the heading is Sent USDT, the signed amount includes the actual fee, and summary rows show Status/Network, Date/Time and Payment/Fee with teal icons. Open Details and verify transaction ID, known sender, recipient and source/destination networks; Open Block Explorer stays at the bottom.

Open an existing received activity. Verify Received USDT and a positive amount. Verify Details shows the verified sender when available and does not invent one for older unknown records. Check pending, failed and transferring rows use their matching icons, and transferring shows its destination.

Prepare a contact payment that accepts multiple payment methods. Open the payment-source button and verify the balance menu shows Savings, Spending, any paired hardware wallet and USDT. Unsupported methods are disabled. Select a supported method and verify its label, available balance and payable amount update. Cancel without paying.
